VERDICT: FAIL

The evidence shows tests pass, but it does not demonstrate that the stale-quote eviction bug was actually fixed (criterion 1). There's no evidence of a code change addressing eviction logic, nor a new/failing-then-passing regression test that specifically reproduces the stale-quote scenario. A green test suite that didn't cover the bug proves nothing about the fix. Need to see the diff and a targeted test that fails before and passes after.
